subject: Isabel
reference_basis: locked front-facing canonical portrait plus locked full-body office references
principle: Store reproducible MPFB morph intent separately from rig/animation. Front-view traits may be tuned confidently; depth/profile traits remain provisional until a real side or three-quarter reference is available.

profile_unknowns.rule: Do not overfit these from a single frontal image. Tune only after a verified three-quarter/profile reference or a rendered comparison exposes an obvious mismatch.

surface.hair: dark brown to black, loosely pinned-up/wavy with face-framing strands
surface.skin_detail: subtle freckles and natural texture, not airbrushed

wardrobe.primary: fitted black professional blazer, dark top, tailored black trousers, black closed-toe heels
wardrobe.jewelry: small gold hoop earrings and fine round-pendant necklace

mpfb_target_strategy.method: Use named MPFB system targets as a deterministic weight vector. Prefer exact target-name matches; MPFB 2.0.17 resolves exact names before partial matches.
mpfb_target_strategy.symmetry: Keep identity-shaping targets symmetric unless the reference shows a stable asymmetry worth preserving.
mpfb_target_strategy.initialization: Start from a neutral adult female macro phenotype, then fit local facial targets. Do not use race macro sliders as a substitute for likeness.

acceptance.identity_gate: A front render must be recognizably the locked Isabel before animation polish is considered complete.
do_not_accept: different face that merely shares hair/wardrobe
beautified drift away from the locked reference
profile guesses that visibly damage front likeness
